description: Applies an approved update and re-queues setup, which replaces the client's live voice agent configuration. Requires agency write access or the client owner, a resolved update with no open conflicts, fresh owner approval, and (unless this client is the canary) an active canary on the same release. Applying an already-applied update changes nothing.

expectedRevision.description: The installation revision you last read. The call is rejected if the installation has changed since.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the approved update.

installationId.description: The agency package installation to act on.

name: agency_installation_apply_update
title: Apply Installation Update
